name: Santiniketan
description: Santiniketan is a school and arts community in rural West Bengal, about 150 km north of Kolkata. Poet Rabindranath Tagore built it from 1901 on the idea that people of all faiths and cultures belong together, and in 1921 it became the Visva Bharati "world university." Its buildings deliberately avoid colonial and European styles, drawing instead on ancient, medieval and folk traditions from across Asia.
